name: Tiszaalpár (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tiszaalpár (a blue shield with a mound, a tree and a fish, inscribed TISZAALPÁR on a scroll).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
